user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Christmas Market Square. A town square Christmas market at night: wooden stalls with striped roofs selling ornaments and treats, a towering Christmas tree wrapped in glowing lights and a star, a small carousel spinning, garlands strung between lamp posts, falling snow, a hot-cocoa stand with steam, wrapped gift piles, townsfolk-scale wooden nutcrackers, and warm light spilling across the trampled snow. Style: festive winter glow. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
